steps.what: Inspect the redesigned vehicle or component test context and actual test records, checking configuration, operating conditions, instrumentation quality and whether the reference and redesigned runs are comparable.

Prepare fuel-use and performance comparisons currently assembled in {SPREADSHEET}; configure native run alignment, unit conversions and comparison plots in automotive test analysis software {OTHER}, checking all exclusions and normalisation choices.
Interpret the comparisons to assess the redesigned component's performance and fuel-efficiency trade-offs, identifying confounding conditions and limits to any claimed improvement.
Write and check the actual redesign findings, comparison references and limitations in the existing analysis record in {DOCS}.
Save the checked final redesign analysis record in {DOCS}.

tasks.design: Configure native run comparisons in automotive test analysis software {OTHER}. The technician verifies comparability, interprets the actual fuel-efficiency and performance results and writes the findings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Run alignment, conversion and comparison plots can be rebuilt manually across redesigned configurations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native analysis presets can reuse explicit run conditions and channel mappings.
tasks.still_hard: Confounding conditions can make an apparent efficiency improvement misleading.
tasks.human_edge: Reject a comparison whose operating conditions do not support the conclusion.

ambition.what: Compare another measured operating condition when a redesign's benefit appears condition-dependent.

tasks.altitude: Less comparison preparation; technical interpretation remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Keep configuration and operating-condition differences visible.

evidence.claim: Test analysis tools can align explicit channels and prepare repeatable comparisons without establishing that two tests are scientifically comparable.

assumptions: Boundary is analysing existing redesign tests through the actual findings record, not performing the tests or adopting a design change. Shares are illustrative.

Test staff supply run ID, vehicle/component revision, timestamp, channel/value/unit, fuel quantity or flow, measured duration, operating condition and quality flags in existing test records. The technician verifies them in s1 and selects channel mappings, comparison windows and permitted conversions in s2. Missing data require manual resolution, with effort retained; no free new instrumentation or inferred reference baseline.

Try native analysis presets before code. Only repeated alignment, conversion and plot preparation lose time. Test runtime, physical inspection, interpretation and actual findings writing do not. Additional measured comparisons are conditional demand, not current saving.
s4's ordinary check binds the completed record for the requested s5 gate without a new approval activity. Changes require rechecking. Save retains one fully counted share.
research_questions: Can native presets retain configuration and exclusion provenance for every comparison?

already_counted.description: Verify channel mappings and review native comparison results.

incremental.description: Maintain run mappings and approved comparison presets.

approvals.approved_version: Final redesign analysis record checked at the end of s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native comparisons remove 45% of the 25-hour preparation share: 11.25 gross hours less 2 upkeep. Zero if already configured. Interpretation, inspection, actual findings writing and save retain full time.

tasks.short: Fabricate or modify prototype components and fixtures

steps.what: Read the current prototype component or fixture drawing, engineering change instructions and manufacturing constraints in {DOCS}, then select the appropriate authorised revision.
Fabricate the new prototype component or modify the existing fixture using the workshop's actual processes, checking physical fit and dimensions against the engineering instructions.
outputs: fabricated or modified prototype and actual deviations

steps.what: Write the actual prototype modifications and deviations in the existing build record in {DOCS}, checking the completed entry against the physical work.
inputs: fabricated or modified prototype and actual deviations

steps.what: Save the checked final prototype build entry in {DOCS}.

tasks.design: Keep fabrication and modification with the technician. Drawing lookup, actual build writing and save are separately examined; existing native revision access and build fields are assumed adequate, so no additional saving is established.
tasks.previous_blocker: The prototype requires physical craft and fit checks.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing controlled drawings support the work but do not fabricate the component.
tasks.still_hard: Material behaviour, fit and unplanned deviations require hands-on judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt to the actual component while keeping deviations explicit.

ambition.what: No automatic fabrication or machinery changes.

tasks.altitude: No demonstrated change to this physical prototype task.

reach.learn: Record the actual physical change and revision reference.

evidence.claim: Controlled build records can document actual modifications but do not perform physical prototype fabrication.

assumptions: Boundary is fabrication or modification through the actual build entry, not a new equipment design or performance test. Lookup and record writing are split from physical work before choosing zero. Shares are illustrative.

The technician verifies part and drawing revision in s1, performs and observes the actual work in s2 and manually records actual changes, deviations and part reference in s3. No completed-work fields are inferred from a planned job.
Native revision views and build fields are already used in this scenario. A template does not eliminate the need to state actual deviations. No new report or approval ceremony is invented.
The ordinary final entry check in s3 binds s4 under the requested commit gate; edits require rechecking. Save retains its real one-share time. No new configuration means zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Current fabrication methods and native build record use
research_questions: Is any actual repeated entry present beyond the existing build fields?

already_counted.description: Write and check actual prototype changes and deviations.

incremental.description: No new process or software introduced.

approvals.approved_version: Final prototype build entry checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Physical fabrication, drawing lookup, actual modification writing and save remain separately counted; no further specific change to the existing process is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Order test equipment, supplies and replacement parts

steps.what: Confirm the actual test-equipment, supply or replacement-part need, inspect existing stock and identify technical compatibility and required quantity.

Find a technically suitable available item and supplier in {PROCUREMENT}; use native approved-catalogue filters and linked item histories to reduce repeated lookup, while checking compatibility, stock and quotation validity.

Prepare the purchase order in {PROCUREMENT}; configure native catalogue-to-order fields and retained delivery details, entering the actual quantity and checking every line, price, delivery address and total against the selected terms and existing spending authority.
outputs: checked final purchase order and supplier destination

steps.what: Commit the checked final purchase order in {PROCUREMENT} under the technician's existing purchasing authority.
inputs: checked final purchase order and supplier destination

steps.what: Send the committed purchase order to its checked supplier destination through {PROCUREMENT}.
inputs: checked final purchase order and supplier destination

tasks.design: Configure native approved-catalogue lookup and catalogue-to-order fields in {PROCUREMENT}. The technician checks the actual need, compatibility and complete order before the separate commit and supplier send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Catalogue details and delivery information can be copied repeatedly into orders.
tasks.enabler_now: Native item and supplier records can populate known order fields while quantities and exceptions remain human decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Part substitutions, equipment compatibility and uncertain stock require technical checking.
tasks.human_edge: Notice that a commercially available item is unsuitable for the test.

ambition.what: No new spending authority or automatic substitution.

tasks.altitude: Less item lookup and order entry, with technical and purchasing responsibility unchanged.

reach.learn: Translate actual test needs into compatible catalogue items.

evidence.claim: Procurement catalogues can populate supplier and item fields in purchase orders without deciding technical compatibility.

assumptions: Boundary is a purchase already within this technician's authority through its supplier order, not delivery or payment. Existing additional purchase approvals still apply where needed; no new rights are granted. Shares are illustrative.

The technician produces actual item specification, observed stock, required quantity and needed date in s1. Procurement records supply item/supplier IDs, catalogue version, price, currency and delivery terms. The technician verifies suitability in s2 and enters project/cost reference, quantity and destination in s3. Missing or non-catalogue items use counted manual quote and entry work; no free stock capture.

Native lookup and order fields precede code. Savings cover repeated catalogue navigation and data copying, not technical selection, physical stock checks or system runtime. Zero if already configured.

The ordinary final-order check at the end of s3 binds the exact lines, totals and supplier destination for both final actions. Edits invalidate it, with no extra self-approval activity. Commit and send each retain their one-share time.
unknowns: Existing catalogue population and lookup features
Technician purchase remit and actual order-entry effort
research_questions: Which order fields are still retyped despite verified catalogue and delivery records?

already_counted.description: Check item suitability, populated order fields and final purchasing details.

incremental.description: Maintain approved catalogue filters, delivery defaults and order-field checks.

approvals.approved_version: Final purchase order checked at the end of s3
Same final order and supplier destination checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native lookup saves 9 hours and order-field reuse saves 19.35, less 3 upkeep: 25.35 net. Zero if these native features already operate. Physical stock checks, actual requirement capture, commit and send retain full time.

tasks.short: Recommend design improvements from test evidence

steps.what: Review verified test findings and actual observations relevant to the product or component, checking configuration, source references and limitations with the engineering team.
Determine a proposed product or component design improvement, weighing the actual test evidence, trade-offs and further verification needed under engineering direction.

Prepare the written design recommendation in {DOCS}; configure native links to existing test figures and source revisions, then check the complete recommendation, limitations and intended engineering recipient against the actual evidence.
outputs: checked final design recommendation and recipient

steps.what: Save the checked final design recommendation in {DOCS}.
inputs: checked final design recommendation and recipient

steps.what: Send the checked final design recommendation to its existing engineering recipient through {EMAIL}.
inputs: checked final design recommendation and recipient

tasks.design: Configure native source links and figure references in {DOCS} for the actual recommendation. Keep evidence review, design judgement and recommendation wording with the technician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recommendations can repeatedly paste test figures and reconstruct their source references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked figures and revision fields reuse existing checked analysis.
tasks.still_hard: A test result does not uniquely determine a beneficial design change.
tasks.human_edge: Recommend a change only when the evidence supports its expected benefit and trade-offs.
tasks.altitude: Less figure and reference preparation; design recommendations remain human.

reach.learn: Separate evidence, proposed change and unverified expectation.

evidence.claim: Native document links can reuse checked test figures while preserving source revisions without determining a design recommendation.

assumptions: Boundary is recommendation preparation through internal delivery. Test analysis in task 19696 is an existing input here; no repeated analysis or observation credit. Engineering authorisation and implementing the change remain separate. Shares are scenarios.

The existing test findings identify component/revision, run and figure IDs, source versions, observed result and limitations. The technician checks these in s1, produces the actual proposed change, rationale and verification need in s2 and selects recipient in s3. Missing evidence requires manual clarification and all recommendation reasoning and prose remain counted.

Native linked figures precede custom code. Only repeated figure insertion and source-reference layout lose time, not discussions, judgement or actual recommendation writing. If no figures are copied or links already work, no saving.

The normal final check in s3 occurs after the complete recommendation exists and binds the file and recipient for both actions. Changes require rechecking; no extra self-approval activity. Save and send each retain their real one-share time.
research_questions: Can native links preserve the exact test revision used by a design recommendation?

already_counted.description: Write and check the completed recommendation with linked evidence.

approvals.approved_version: Final design recommendation checked at the end of s3
Same final recommendation and recipient checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native evidence links remove 20% of the 33-hour recommendation preparation share: 6.6 gross hours less 1 upkeep. Zero if already linked. Evidence discussions, design judgement, save and send retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
